subject.title: [Bug]: Memory dreaming narrative/REM lane is given apply_patch and misuses it

question: Should plugin-owned subagent runs get a typed no-tools or `toolsAllow` contract now so memory-core Dream Diary narrative runs can run without workspace-mutating tools?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the repair changes a plugin runtime and gateway security contract rather than a single memory-core implementation detail.

options.title: Add plugin subagent tool policy
options.body: Extend `SubagentRunParams`, gateway `agent` validation/dispatch, and memory-core narrative calls so prose-only plugin subagents can request an explicit no-tools policy with focused regression coverage.

options.title: Sequence after sessions_spawn policy
options.body: Wait for the open `sessions_spawn.toolsAllow` work to settle, then extend the same accepted semantics to plugin runtime subagents in a follow-up.

options.title: Use prompt-only mitigation
options.body: Only harden `NARRATIVE_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, accepting that the mutating tool remains available and recurring tool-call log noise may continue with weak models.

recommendation.title: Add plugin subagent tool policy
recommendation.body: Extend `SubagentRunParams`, gateway `agent` validation/dispatch, and memory-core narrative calls so prose-only plugin subagents can request an explicit no-tools policy with focused regression coverage.
